programmes.label: Flexible pocket park
programmes.description: Draw an irregular small park. Lawn, shade and seating adapt to the space.
programmes.reshapeDescription: Draw or reshape a simple, non-crossing outline. The lawn and planting adapt; benches and trees keep their real size. Supported area: 64–3,600 m².

programmes.label: Flexible linear greenway
programmes.description: Draw a long, varied-width corridor with a continuous walking trail.
programmes.reshapeDescription: Keep a connected corridor at least 60 m long, 12–60 m wide and three times longer than wide. The clear trail and planting adapt to its outline.

programmes.label: Flexible shade courtyard
programmes.description: A quiet contemporary courtyard with clear lawn, shade trees and seating. Draw its outline to fit a small leftover space.
programmes.reshapeDescription: Draw a simple outline of 64–3,600 m². Lawn and circulation adapt; benches and trees keep their real size and need clear space.

programmes.label: Flexible meadow grove
programmes.description: A natural pocket refuge with meadow textures, irregular shade trees and timber seating. Draw a tapered or angled garden outline.
programmes.reshapeDescription: Draw a simple outline of 64–3,600 m². Planting adapts to the parcel; paths and fixed-size furniture must fit inside it. This is a visual planting concept, not a habitat assessment.
